scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-webhook --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:all"
scripts.test:all: cd client && npx vitest run && cd ../functions && npm test
scripts.test:watch: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-webhook --only auth,firestore,functions "cd client && npx vitest"
scripts.test:coverage: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-webhook --only auth,firestore,functions "cd client && npx vitest run --coverage"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-webhook --only auth,firestore "cd client && npx vitest run --testPathPattern=firestore.rules"
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-webhook --only auth,firestore,functions "cd functions && npm test"
scripts.start: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-webhook "cd client && npx vite --host --mode development"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../functions && npm install
